title.narrative: Program to Strengthen the Electricity Sector in Nicaragua III
Programa para Fortalecer el Sector Elctrico en Nicaragua III

description.narrative: The general objective of the program is to support the Government of Nicaragua in consolidating a sector framework to guarantee the financial and operational sustainability of the sector. This is the third in a series of three programmatic policy-based loan (PBP) operations. The specific objectives are: (i) macroeconomic stability; (ii) guaranteeing the financial sustainability of the electricity sector; (iii) improving the transparency of sector management results; (iv) promoting a sustainable energy matrix, by encouraging renewable energy, private investment, and energy efficiency; and (v) promoting regional integration of the electricity sector.

el objetivo general del programa es apoyar al Gobierno de Nicaragua (GNI), en la consolidacin de un marco sectorial que garantice la sostenibilidad financiera y operativa del sector. Esta es la tercera de una serie de tres operaciones de Prstamo Programtico en Apoyo a Reformas de Poltica (PBP), cuyos objetivos especficos son: (i) estabilidad macroeconmica; (ii) garantizar la sostenibilidad financiera del sector elctrico; (iii) mejorar la transparencia de resultados en la gestin del sector; (iv) promover una matriz energtica sostenible, fomentando las energas renovables, la inversin privada y la eficiencia energtica; y (v) impulsar la integracin regional del sector elctrico.
